storytelling.badge: Seva First Innovation Challenge — Eastern Zone
storytelling.title: Why LokSetu?
storytelling.subtitle: Bridging philatelic heritage with rural livelihood transformation across West Bengal, Bihar, and Jharkhand.
storytelling.problemDesc: Traditional artisans, youth tour guides, and rural homestay hosts across Eastern India struggle to reach travelers and collectors. Trapped by exploitative middlemen, they receive less than 30% of fair value, while historic philatelic treasures and rural heritage remain forgotten.
storytelling.solutionDesc: A unified platform connecting postage stamps -> living destinations -> rural communities. LokSetu enables zero-middlemen direct bookings, verified handicraft sales, and 90% direct payouts to local craftspeople and homestays.
storytelling.impactDesc: Measurable, transparent economic empowerment. Direct digital payments via UPI, revival of endangered crafts, and sustainable livelihood security for artisan cooperatives across Eastern India.
